_comment: Every seller the routine must reach. recipe: shopify|woocommerce feeds are pulled by tools/sweep.py (feed template, {page} and {brand}); html sources the agent searches and fetches for every selected brand every run (search template or a site-scoped web search); snippet sources block the fetcher, so only search snippets. brands 'auto' = decided by the feed's vendor field or the search. status is maintained by the sweep and the routine: last_status ok|blocked|empty|error, last_ok, last_listings, last_checked. Never delete an entry; set its status instead.
